remarks: Fabulous new construction home in the heart of Pemberwick. Enter into the light and bright first floor with a large living room and modern fireplace. The spacious kitchen with a breakfast bar is open to a dining area, or you can eat on the deck overlooking the back yard. One bedroom and full bathroom complete the main floor. Second floor has two additional bedrooms w/ a hall bath and the primary bedroom w/ walk-in closet and en-suite bath. A laundry room and ample storage are also on the second floor. Additional hallway space is perfect for an office set up or homework station! The finished basement is the perfect bonus room with its own full bath and walk out to the yard. Located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. Walk to Pemberwick Park!  1st fl 1752 sqft 2nd fl 1269 sqft LL 965 sqft

facts.laundryLoc: Laundry room in second floor hallway
